$comment: The renewal digest's copy, one block per SUPPORTED locale of the locale register (tooling/i18n/locales.json).
tooling/ci/assert-locale-register.mjs L7 holds the block set to the register's supported set and every block
to the English block's keys. reminders.ts picks the block by the person's stored `locale` preference and
falls back to `en` for a locale with no block, an unset preference, or an app database with no preferences.
{name} {date} {count} {app} are filled by buildDigest. ta and hi are agent-produced and unreviewed.

en.why: You get this because you switched on renewal reminder emails in {app}.
